title: Old Silver Bird
style: rock, rock, mid-tempo, southern rock, blues rock, gritty male vocals, smooth male vocals, female vocals, blues, drone, somber, rich, loud, hard rock, gospel, smooth, soaring, sleep, soulful, soul, southern rock, classic, metal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[gritty singing]
From the west side of Jacksonville
The dirt and the heat
We built a southern empire
Out of the street
Ten years of brawlin'
Of sweat and of sound
Now we're kings of the highway
Tearin' it down
They tried to tell us
We played it too loud
But we gave 'em our blood
And we captured the crowd
Street survivors
That's what we are
Ridin' the lightnin'
Reaching the star
Got this old silver bird
She rattles and shakes
Said she ain't got the brakes
But we're a band of brothers
We're too tough to bend
Just one more flight on her
Then this chapter will end

[Verse 2]
[smooth male vocals]
I came from Miami
Looking for a way in
Cassie made the call
Said
"Come see where we've been"
They gave me a chance
On a Saturday night
Plugged in my Strat
And the magic was right
Now I'm writin' the riffs
I'm sharin' the stage
With the biggest damn band
Of the southern rock age
We just dropped the record
The cover's on fire
I never thought I could climb any higher
Lookin' out the window at the South Carolina sun
Thinkin' about the music and the things we've just done
Baton Rouge is waitin'
The crowd's gonna roar
Just a boy from Oklahoma
Couldn't ask for much more

[Chorus]
We are the free birds flyin' so high
We painted our names straight across the blue sky
From the swamps of the south to the top of the chart
We played every note from the bottom of our heart
But the engines are coughin'
The fire is spittin'
The gauge says empty
But nobody's quittin'
Hold on to your brothers
The trees are so near
The end of the song is comin' right here

[Verse 3]
[soulful female vocals]
I was a honkette
Singin' the soul
Helpin' this wild machine
Rock and roll
I brought Stevie in
I knew what he had
To see him up there
Makes a sister so glad
But this plane is a ghost
I feel it in my bones
It groans like a spirit
That's lost and alone
The right engine sputtered on the flight yesterday
Now it's throwin' out sparks in a terrifying way
I look back at Stevie
He's tryin' to sleep
He don't see the sparks
Don't know we're in deep
So I walk up to Ronnie
He's tryin' to get a nap
Said
"I don't want to bother
But the engine's gonna snap"
I know we can fly
We ain't scared of crashin'
But I'm scared of dyin'
He said
"Baby
What's the difference?
I've been runnin' from the reaper
And the songs don't stop
Just 'cause the singer goes deeper
I've been tired of breathin'
Since I was a boy
It ain't no use leavin'
But it ain't no joy"
Then he looks at the flames
And the fear hits his eyes
He shouts
"Baby
Tell me the truth
Do we die?"
I say
"Oh
We die
Oh
We die"

[Bridge]
The old silver bird
She rattles and shakes
Said she ain't got the brakes
But we're a band of brothers
We're too tough to bend
Just one more flight on her
Then this chapter will end

[Chorus]
We are the free birds flyin' so high
We painted our names straight across the blue sky
From the swamps of the south to the top of the chart
We played every note from the bottom of our heart
But the engines are coughin'
The fire is spittin'
The gauge says empty
But nobody's quittin'
Hold on to your brothers
The trees are so near
The end of the song is comin' right here
[Bridge]
[drone]
[music stumbles]
[long heavy outro]
